title: Matrix project organisation
goal: Show functional ownership and shared project assignments.

rubric.must: Engineering, Design, and PMO Delivery visibly report to the COO.
Engineers and designer visibly have functional-manager reporting lines.
Atlas project manager has visibly dashed Atlas project links to an engineer and designer.
Beacon project manager has a visibly dashed Beacon project link to the test engineer.
Solid and dashed relationships can be distinguished without label overlap.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the orgchart/tree exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The diagram shows Engineering, Design, and Delivery reporting to the COO; staff report through their functional managers; and all three labeled dashed project links are traceable without obscuring the solid reporting lines.

items.evidence: Solid lines from the COO connect to Engineering Manager Jamie Wu, Design Manager Casey Brown, and PMO Director Jordan Fox.
Morgan Lee and Riley Scott connect to Jamie Wu; Taylor King connects to Casey Brown.
Two dashed green links labeled “Atlas project” connect Ari Bennett to Morgan Lee and Taylor King.
A dashed green link labeled “Beacon project” connects Skyler Diaz to Riley Scott.
Solid reporting lines are thin gray and project links are dashed green; labels are readable and do not obscure the connections.
